caption: The drawing features a central cluster of large, multi-layered flowers with rounded petals, primarily in various shades of red and white, along with some flowers displaying blue, yellow, and pink accents. The flowers are surrounded by a dense arrangement of broad leaves rendered in green, with yellow, brown, and red tinges. The background consists of a repeating diamond lattice pattern in dark brown and beige, creating a geometric contrast to the organic shapes of the floral foreground. The overall composition fills the central rectangular area of the drawing, leaving a blank beige border around the edges. The elements are tightly interwoven, with stems, leaves, and flowers overlapping and extending toward the edge of the central rectangle.
title: Patchwork Bedspread Material
